key: blades of steel (1990)(novotrade)[cr pna]/Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: load_boot_image_via_doio
description: Issues a chain of exec device I/O requests with DoIO to fetch the boot data, then writes the interrupt and DMA disable mask to the global control register and copies a 4 KB block of the loaded image to low memory.

key: blades of steel (1990)(novotrade)[cr pna]/Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf:bootblock:0:0260
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only decrements a word through an address register and then hits invalid instruction data, so it is a stub with no usable behaviour.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:020A
name: seek_track_find_sync
description: Compares the requested track with the current track and, when they differ, steps the drive head toward it, then reads raw data until the disk sync marker appears.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:02A8
name: copy_words_from_offset
description: Copies a block of words from a source address made of a stored base plus an offset into the destination pointer, with the word count taken from the data register.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:02C0
name: decode_mfm_sector_blocks
description: Runs a fixed number of passes that take the odd and even bit fields of raw disk data, recombine them with the alternating-bit mask into decoded words, and store each pass at a destination chosen by the sector number.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:0334
name: skip_to_disk_sync_word
description: Advances through raw disk data until the disk sync marker is found, then skips any further consecutive sync markers, leaving the read pointer on the first non-sync word.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:034E
name: step_head_to_track
description: Steps the drive head one track at a time toward the target track, setting the direction bit in the disk control port before each step and updating the stored track count until the current track matches the target.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:03B2
name: wait_disk_block_complete
description: Polls the cached interrupt request value until the disk block complete flag is set, then clears that flag by writing it back to the interrupt request register.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:03D0
name: wait_drive_ready_after_delay
description: Runs a short countdown delay loop and then polls the disk ready bit of the CIA port until the drive reports ready.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:03EC
name: recalibrate_head_to_track_zero
description: Steps the drive head outward one track at a time while the track zero sensor bit in the CIA port is still set, then resets the stored track count to zero.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:0420
name: wait_disk_index_flag
description: Polls the CIA B interrupt control register until its disk index flag bit is set, then returns the value passed in.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:043E
name: select_disk_drive_line
description: Derives a drive number from the low bits of its argument, sets that drive's select line in the disk control port, and holds it through a 256-count loop before calling a wait routine and clearing the control value.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:047E
name: stop_disk_motor
description: Sets the motor control bit in the disk control port, pulses the selected drive's select line through a 256-count loop, and then marks the stored control value as fully set.

name: start_blitter_from_parameters
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, then copies a block of parameter words into the blitter pointer, modulo, mask, control and size registers, which starts the blit.

name: poll_status_until_clear
description: Returns early when a status word is negative; otherwise it repeatedly calls device access routines, stores each returned value, and loops until the high part of the returned value is zero.

name: forward_call_single_helper
description: Does nothing except call one other routine and return, so it is a thin forwarding wrapper with no added logic.

name: copy_table_entry_to_buffers
description: When an enabled status word is non-negative, reads an entry from a lookup table selected by a stored index and a flag bit, then writes its fields into two parallel buffers at a position offset and updates a shadow copy.

name: tick_counter_with_helpers
description: Calls two helper routines, increments a 16-bit counter stored in the runtime block, and then calls a third helper.

name: store_long_pair_into_tables
description: Writes two 32-bit values, each split into high and low words, into two parallel tables at a shared index, filling four words per table entry.

name: load_table_entry_into_record
description: Reads a long from a pointer table chosen by an index, adds a word from the same table entry to it, stores the sum in a record, then sets two 16-bit fields to all ones and clears another.

name: setup_paired_blit_rows
description: Fills a blit parameter record with a fixed size and source and destination addresses, starts a blit for the first set of rows, and when a stored status word is non-negative and a condition holds, repeats the setup for a second set of rows at an offset.

name: update_deltas_and_clamp
description: Updates the x and y deltas by subtracting stored reference values when the matching flag bits are set, then forces the x value to minus 128 whenever it falls outside a fixed window.

name: write_sprite_control_words
description: Computes vertical start and end values from a Y position and an offset, and a horizontal start from an X position, then writes them as control bytes into a sprite data block and clears the trailing words once a stored count reaches zero.

name: setup_shifted_blit_copy
description: Writes a fixed set of blitter parameter words, with a shift taken from the low nibble of an argument placed into the control word, then starts the blit and clears a flag.

name: start_conditional_blit
description: When a state mask is nonzero, programs a blit with a control word built from a stored shift, adjusts the source address by a fixed amount when one flag is set, and then starts the blit.

name: copy_pointer_when_flagged
description: When a flag bit is set, copies a stored pointer into a record field, calls one helper, and clears a word in the record.

name: write_split_long_to_tables
description: Reads a 32-bit value through a stored pointer, writes its high and low words into two parallel tables at an offset position, then calls two helper routines.

name: setup_cia_timer_interrupt
description: Stores a handler routine address together with timer, control and interrupt values for the CIA A timer and interrupt registers, and enables the selected interrupt sources through the interrupt enable register.

name: handle_vblank_frame_update
description: Runs when the vertical blank request flag is set: it advances a frame counter and sequence timing values, calls several update routines when a stored step is reached, and acknowledges the interrupt by writing the request bits back.

name: stub_return_stack_value
description: Returns the value found at the top of the stack without doing anything else, so it is a stub with no other behaviour.

name: swap_double_buffer_pointers
description: When a stored status word is non-negative, resets a counter, swaps each pair of current and alternate buffer pointers, and stores the new front pointer, or zero when a flag is set.

name: compute_position_deltas
description: Computes the x and y differences between target and current positions, copies several state fields into working fields, and clears a counter.

name: fill_eight_strided_bytes
description: Calculates a byte offset from an x and y position using a fixed row stride, calls a helper, then writes all-ones bytes into eight locations spaced by a fixed row step.

name: step_position_within_bounds
description: Moves a coordinate by two in the direction selected by flag bits, clamps it at its limits, and clears the matching direction bits when a limit is reached.

name: mark_table_entries_empty
description: Computes a table index from a row stride and position, streams helper output until a zero is returned, then sets two table entries to all ones and marks a pending flag.

name: blit_four_plane_copies
description: Runs four blits in sequence, waiting for the blitter to go idle before each one, with a copy control word, full edge masks, and source and destination addresses that advance by a row step and a plane step.

name: blit_four_plane_pairs_swapped
description: Runs four blits like its neighbour but loads the source and destination address registers in the opposite order.

name: copy_tile_into_planes_indexed
description: Copies a 32-byte tile from a table selected by an index into four bitplanes, writing eight bytes per plane with each byte stepping down the rows at a fixed row stride.

name: copy_tile_bytes_to_planes
description: Copies a 32-byte block from a source pointer into four bitplanes, writing eight bytes per plane with each byte stepping down the rows at a fixed row stride.

name: write_four_coordinate_pairs
description: Computes four positions from a shared vertical base and per-entry values, adjusted by a small offset when a low nibble is zero, then writes each as high and low words into two parallel tables.

name: wait_for_flag_then_clear
description: Busy-waits until a flag word in the runtime block becomes nonzero, then resets that flag to zero.

name: start_plane_blit_from_table
description: Looks up a value from a table by its argument, waits for the blitter to go idle, then sets destination pointers at three plane offsets, edge masks to all ones and modulo and control values that start the blit.

name: copy_words_to_three_tables
description: Copies 32 words from a source buffer into one working table and into two parallel tables, advancing a shared offset by four bytes at each step.

name: clear_state_word
description: Stores zero into a single 16-bit state word, which resets that flag.

name: reset_runtime_state_block
description: Sets four 32-bit position entries to all ones, clears several pointer-based and state words, and sets two state words to their initial values.

name: run_table_setup_sequence
description: Passes a computed table address to a helper, then calls two further helpers in sequence, so it is a short orchestration routine.

name: copy_words_to_runtime_buffer
description: Copies sixteen words from an argument block into a fixed runtime buffer and passes that buffer to a helper routine.

name: emit_rows_until_terminator
description: When a count is nonzero, sets up a record with fixed values and a computed address, then calls a helper and advances the address by a row step until the helper returns zero.

name: process_flagged_list_entries
description: Walks a list of six-byte entries and, for each entry whose flag is negative, computes destination addresses from a base and per-entry offsets, sets up a record, and fills it through helper calls.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:0000
name: init_display_and_run_titles
description: Program entry point: allocates memory for the copper list and screen buffers, clears the screen and a block of custom registers, programs the display window, bitplane modulos and colour registers, then runs the title sequence.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:00E2
name: wait_frame_and_swap_screens
description: Waits for the raster position to reach the next frame, swaps the current and previous screen buffers, and rewrites the copper list bitplane pointers for each display row group before ending the list.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:0148
name: clear_current_screen
description: Zeroes the current screen buffer with long-word stores working backwards from its end in unrolled groups, then continues into the title area clear.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:0154
name: clear_title_area
description: Zeroes a block of the current screen starting at a fixed offset, using unrolled long-word stores, which clears the title region.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:019C
name: draw_scaled_logo_frame
description: Draws one frame of the logo at the current scale: it computes the screen position from the scale value, looks up a shrink table entry for each row, and copies the shifted logo pixels into the current screen buffer.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:02A4
name: grow_logo_animation
description: Runs the growth animation: for each scale from 1 to 16 it clears the title area, draws the logo at that scale, and waits for a frame.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:02DA
name: shrink_logo_animation
description: Runs the reverse animation: starting at scale 16 and counting down to zero, it clears the title area, draws the logo at each scale, and waits for a frame.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:0308
name: show_title_sequence
description: Clears the screen twice with a frame wait between, copies eight palette entries into the colour registers, then runs the logo sequence.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1ADC
name: copy_screen_to_background
description: Copies the previous screen buffer into the background buffer row by row using unrolled long-word moves, then continues into the general buffer copy.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1AE6
name: copy_background_to_screen
description: Copies the background buffer into the current screen buffer row by row using unrolled long-word moves, then continues into the general buffer copy.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1AEE
name: copy_buffer_rows
description: Copies a fixed number of rows from a source address to a destination address using unrolled long-word moves.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1B22
name: clear_screen_backwards
description: Zeroes a region of the current screen buffer by writing long-word zeros backwards from a point near its end, in unrolled stores.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1B58
name: generate_ripple_table
description: Fills the load buffer with a ripple profile: a constant block, then 368 values read from the cosine table at a stepped phase and halved, then another constant block.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1BA4
name: plot_ripple_rows
description: Calls the line plotter once for each of 92 ripple rows.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1BD0
name: plot_lines_until_limit
description: Repeatedly calls the line plotter while advancing an accumulator by a fixed step, stopping when the accumulator reaches its limit.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1C22
name: draw_clipped_line_segment
description: Computes a horizontal segment from a scaled coordinate pair, clamps its ends to the 320-pixel screen width, and writes the pixel mask words into the screen buffer one word at a time.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1D5A
name: draw_text_entries_until_end
description: Walks a text table two words at a time, calling the letter drawer for each entry and moving the horizontal position by a fixed amount, and returns when a sentinel value marks the end of the table.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1D80
name: draw_text_entries_past_threshold
description: Walks the same text table, drawing each letter only once the horizontal position passes a fixed threshold, advancing the position each step until the sentinel is reached.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1DA6
name: dispatch_letter_handler
description: Looks up a handler offset in a table using a stored index, then calls the selected letter-drawing routine through a computed jump.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1DE8
name: dispatch_moveto_command
description: Calls the handler chosen by a table entry at a fixed field offset through a computed jump, which is used to move the drawing position.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1DFE
name: draw_rectangle_then_dispatch
description: Draws a rectangle from the current arguments, then calls a handler selected by a table value through a computed jump.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1E1E
name: draw_rectangle_then_dispatch
description: Draws a rectangle from the current arguments, then calls a handler selected by a table value through a computed jump.

name: draw_rectangle_then_dispatch_alt

name: draw_rectangle_then_dispatch_alt

name: clip_and_draw_rectangle
description: Clamps the rectangle corners to the 320 by 200 screen area, rejects empty rectangles, computes the byte and bit positions of its edges, then hands it to the thin-rectangle routine or a return stub.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1F60
name: draw_thin_strip_rows
description: Applies a one-word mask to a vertical strip row by row across four bitplanes, setting or clearing bits in each plane so the strip takes the colour the mask encodes.

key: pipe mania (1989)(empire)[cr oracle][b]/Pipe Mania (1989)(Empire)[cr Oracle][b].adf:Load PipeMania:0:1F82
name: run_logo_ripple_sequence
description: Opens the system libraries, grows the logo, generates the ripple table, plays shrinking and rippling frames in turn, copies the result to the background and draws the title text.

name: copy_vectors_and_clear_memory
description: Copies a block of routine addresses to a fixed low-memory area, clears two large memory blocks with long-word zeros, then calls four helpers.

name: dispatch_indirect_jump
description: Makes an indirect call through a jump table that the decompiler could not recover, so the final target is not visible in this evidence.

name: write_nop_patch_and_clear
description: Writes no-operation instruction words into a low-memory location, copies a block of routine addresses to a fixed low-memory area, and clears a large memory block with long-word zeros.

name: setup_registers_and_call_helpers
description: Loads a set of pointer and data registers from the caller's values and then calls three helper routines, so it works as a register setup entry point.

name: fade_colour_nibbles_step
description: Every fourth call, steps through a table of colour words and decrements each non-zero red, green and blue nibble, which fades the palette by one step.

name: run_blitter_copy_loop
description: Repeatedly programs the blitter with source, destination, modulo and control values for four passes, with the addresses computed from a scroll position.

name: render_character_glyphs
description: Maps each character of the text to a glyph in the font table using a fixed character base, stops at the end-of-text marker, and copies the glyph data into the screen buffer.

name: forbid_restore_state_enable_dma
description: Forbids multitasking around a system library call, restores a saved state pointer, sets a stored address field, and writes a DMA enable mask that turns on several channels.

name: init_sequence_from_table
description: Clears a counter, stores a value looked up in a fixed ten-entry table with the index clamped to nine, sets a companion byte to one, and calls five helper routines.

name: take_pending_value
description: Copies a pending value into the working variable and then clears the pending slot.

name: set_clamped_count_and_nibble
description: Stores its first argument, clamped to a maximum of 64, in one state word, and stores the low four bits of its second argument in another.

name: advance_countdown_step
description: Decrements a countdown; when it reaches zero it reloads the countdown and runs one set of four helpers, otherwise it runs another set of four helpers, then stores a marked value and clears the pending slot.

name: advance_channel_sound_stream
description: Decrements a channel's step counter and, when it expires, decodes the next packed event from the channel's stream, handling flag bits that select between stored values and updating the channel state.

name: advance_second_channel_stream
description: Applies the same packed-event decoding as its neighbour to a second channel record at different field offsets.

name: select_channel_destination
description: Chooses a destination for the current channel's value, falling back to a global slot when a channel mask is zero, and computes the address of the channel's 24-byte instrument entry.

name: update_channel_period_and_vibrato
description: Updates a channel's period and vibrato state from its instrument entry, applying a counter-driven sweep and a sign flip, then stores the new period and volume.

name: set_clamped_count_and_nibble
description: Stores its first argument, clamped to a maximum of 64, in one state word, and stores the low four bits of its second argument in another.

name: init_channel_from_stream
description: Clears a channel field and loads a period value from the stream pointer, scales it by a shift into a second field, then zeroes the remaining channel fields.

key: blades of steel (1990)(novotrade)[cr pna][a]/Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: load_boot_image_via_doio
description: Issues a chain of exec device I/O requests with DoIO to fetch the boot data, then writes the interrupt and DMA disable mask to the global control register and copies a 4 KB block of the loaded image to low memory.

key: blades of steel (1990)(novotrade)[cr pna][a]/Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf:bootblock:0:0260
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only decrements a word through an address register and then hits invalid instruction data, so it is a stub with no usable behaviour.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:020A
name: seek_track_find_sync
description: Compares the requested track with the current track and, when they differ, steps the drive head toward it, then reads raw data until the disk sync marker appears.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:02A8
name: copy_words_from_offset
description: Copies a block of words from a source address made of a stored base plus an offset into the destination pointer, with the word count taken from the data register.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:02C0
name: decode_mfm_sector_blocks
description: Runs a fixed number of passes that take the odd and even bit fields of raw disk data, recombine them with the alternating-bit mask into decoded words, and store each pass at a destination chosen by the sector number.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:0334
name: skip_to_disk_sync_word
description: Advances through raw disk data until the disk sync marker is found, then skips any further consecutive sync markers, leaving the read pointer on the first non-sync word.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:034E
name: step_head_to_track
description: Steps the drive head one track at a time toward the target track, setting the direction bit in the disk control port before each step and updating the stored track count until the current track matches the target.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:03B2
name: wait_disk_block_complete
description: Polls the cached interrupt request value until the disk block complete flag is set, then clears that flag by writing it back to the interrupt request register.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:03D0
name: wait_drive_ready_after_delay
description: Runs a short countdown delay loop and then polls the disk ready bit of the CIA port until the drive reports ready.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:03EC
name: recalibrate_head_to_track_zero
description: Steps the drive head outward one track at a time while the track zero sensor bit in the CIA port is still set, then resets the stored track count to zero.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:0420
name: wait_disk_index_flag
description: Polls the CIA B interrupt control register until its disk index flag bit is set, then returns the value passed in.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:043E
name: select_disk_drive_line
description: Derives a drive number from the low bits of its argument, sets that drive's select line in the disk control port, and holds it through a 256-count loop before calling a wait routine and clearing the control value.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr PNA][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:047E
name: stop_disk_motor
description: Sets the motor control bit in the disk control port, pulses the selected drive's select line through a 256-count loop, and then marks the stored control value as fully set.

name: start_blitter_from_parameters
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, then copies a block of parameter words into the blitter pointer, modulo, mask, control and size registers, which starts the blit.

name: poll_status_until_clear
description: Returns early when a status word is negative; otherwise it repeatedly calls device access routines, stores each returned value, and loops until the high part of the returned value is zero.

name: forward_call_single_helper
description: Does nothing except call one other routine and return, so it is a thin forwarding wrapper with no added logic.

name: copy_table_entry_to_buffers
description: When an enabled status word is non-negative, reads an entry from a lookup table selected by a stored index and a flag bit, then writes its fields into two parallel buffers at a position offset and updates a shadow copy.

name: tick_counter_with_helpers
description: Calls two helper routines, increments a 16-bit counter stored in the runtime block, and then calls a third helper.

name: store_long_pair_into_tables
description: Writes two 32-bit values, each split into high and low words, into two parallel tables at a shared index, filling four words per table entry.

name: load_table_entry_into_record
description: Reads a long from a pointer table chosen by an index, adds a word from the same table entry to it, stores the sum in a record, then sets two 16-bit fields to all ones and clears another.

name: setup_paired_blit_rows
description: Fills a blit parameter record with a fixed size and source and destination addresses, starts a blit for the first set of rows, and when a stored status word is non-negative and a condition holds, repeats the setup for a second set of rows at an offset.

name: update_deltas_and_clamp
description: Updates the x and y deltas by subtracting stored reference values when the matching flag bits are set, then forces the x value to minus 128 whenever it falls outside a fixed window.

name: write_sprite_control_words
description: Computes vertical start and end values from a Y position and an offset, and a horizontal start from an X position, then writes them as control bytes into a sprite data block and clears the trailing words once a stored count reaches zero.

name: setup_shifted_blit_copy
description: Writes a fixed set of blitter parameter words, with a shift taken from the low nibble of an argument placed into the control word, then starts the blit and clears a flag.

name: start_conditional_blit
description: When a state mask is nonzero, programs a blit with a control word built from a stored shift, adjusts the source address by a fixed amount when one flag is set, and then starts the blit.

name: copy_pointer_when_flagged
description: When a flag bit is set, copies a stored pointer into a record field, calls one helper, and clears a word in the record.

name: write_split_long_to_tables
description: Reads a 32-bit value through a stored pointer, writes its high and low words into two parallel tables at an offset position, then calls two helper routines.

name: setup_cia_timer_interrupt
description: Stores a handler routine address together with timer, control and interrupt values for the CIA A timer and interrupt registers, and enables the selected interrupt sources through the interrupt enable register.

name: handle_vblank_frame_update
description: Runs when the vertical blank request flag is set: it advances a frame counter and sequence timing values, calls several update routines when a stored step is reached, and acknowledges the interrupt by writing the request bits back.

name: stub_return_stack_value
description: Returns the value found at the top of the stack without doing anything else, so it is a stub with no other behaviour.

name: swap_double_buffer_pointers
description: When a stored status word is non-negative, resets a counter, swaps each pair of current and alternate buffer pointers, and stores the new front pointer, or zero when a flag is set.

name: compute_position_deltas
description: Computes the x and y differences between target and current positions, copies several state fields into working fields, and clears a counter.

name: fill_eight_strided_bytes
description: Calculates a byte offset from an x and y position using a fixed row stride, calls a helper, then writes all-ones bytes into eight locations spaced by a fixed row step.

name: step_position_within_bounds
description: Moves a coordinate by two in the direction selected by flag bits, clamps it at its limits, and clears the matching direction bits when a limit is reached.

name: mark_table_entries_empty
description: Computes a table index from a row stride and position, streams helper output until a zero is returned, then sets two table entries to all ones and marks a pending flag.

name: blit_four_plane_copies
description: Runs four blits in sequence, waiting for the blitter to go idle before each one, with a copy control word, full edge masks, and source and destination addresses that advance by a row step and a plane step.

name: blit_four_plane_pairs_swapped
description: Runs four blits like its neighbour but loads the source and destination address registers in the opposite order.

name: copy_tile_into_planes_indexed
description: Copies a 32-byte tile from a table selected by an index into four bitplanes, writing eight bytes per plane with each byte stepping down the rows at a fixed row stride.

name: copy_tile_bytes_to_planes
description: Copies a 32-byte block from a source pointer into four bitplanes, writing eight bytes per plane with each byte stepping down the rows at a fixed row stride.

name: write_four_coordinate_pairs
description: Computes four positions from a shared vertical base and per-entry values, adjusted by a small offset when a low nibble is zero, then writes each as high and low words into two parallel tables.

name: wait_for_flag_then_clear
description: Busy-waits until a flag word in the runtime block becomes nonzero, then resets that flag to zero.

name: start_plane_blit_from_table
description: Looks up a value from a table by its argument, waits for the blitter to go idle, then sets destination pointers at three plane offsets, edge masks to all ones and modulo and control values that start the blit.

name: copy_words_to_three_tables
description: Copies 32 words from a source buffer into one working table and into two parallel tables, advancing a shared offset by four bytes at each step.

name: clear_state_word
description: Stores zero into a single 16-bit state word, which resets that flag.

name: reset_runtime_state_block
description: Sets four 32-bit position entries to all ones, clears several pointer-based and state words, and sets two state words to their initial values.

name: run_table_setup_sequence
description: Passes a computed table address to a helper, then calls two further helpers in sequence, so it is a short orchestration routine.

name: copy_words_to_runtime_buffer
description: Copies sixteen words from an argument block into a fixed runtime buffer and passes that buffer to a helper routine.

name: emit_rows_until_terminator
description: When a count is nonzero, sets up a record with fixed values and a computed address, then calls a helper and advances the address by a row step until the helper returns zero.

name: process_flagged_list_entries
description: Walks a list of six-byte entries and, for each entry whose flag is negative, computes destination addresses from a base and per-entry offsets, sets up a record, and fills it through helper calls.
